name: Rodin V2
description: Rodin by Hyper3D generates realistic and production ready 3D models from text or images.

action.description: Rodin by Hyper3D generates realistic and production ready 3D models from text or images.
action.name: fal-ai/hyper3d/rodin/v2

TAPose.description: Generate characters in T-pose or A-pose format, making them easier to rig and animate in 3D software.
TAPose.title: Tapose

bbox_condition.description: An array that specifies the bounding box dimensions [width, height, length].
bbox_condition.title: Bbox Condition

material.description: Material type. PBR: Physically-based materials with realistic lighting. Shaded: Simple materials with baked lighting. All: Both types included.
material.title: Material

preview_render.description: Generate a preview render image of the 3D model along with the model files.
preview_render.title: Preview Render

quality_mesh_option.description: Combined quality and mesh type selection. Quad = smooth surfaces, Triangle = detailed geometry.
quality_mesh_option.title: Quality Mesh Option

seed.description: Seed value for random number generator. Uncheck for reproducible results.
seed.title: Seed

use_original_alpha.description: When enabled, preserves the transparency channel from input images during 3D generation.
use_original_alpha.title: Use Original Alpha
